newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices firm on limited arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices firm on limited arrivals.

text.p: Indian sugar prices rose slightly on Friday on limited arrivals and speculative activity ahead of the budget to be presently later in the day, dealers said.

"Some traders are expecting the finance minister to raise excise duty on sugar in the budget. At present excise duty on sugar is 85 rupees per 100 kg which may be hiked to 100 rupees," one broker said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by 5/20 rupees to 1,245/1,295 rupees per quintal while M-30 rose by 2/5 rupees to 1,275/1,350 rupees per quintal.
Sugar mill delivery remained untraded as millers had already sold the entire free sale quota for the current month. Free sale quota for current month was 700,000 tonnes and for March it is unchanged.
